name: jesse-agent-vscode
description: VS Code frontend for the local Jesse Agent core.

commands.title: Jesse Agent: Ask About Current File

jesseAgent.agentRoot.description: Path to the jesse-agent project root. Leave empty to auto-detect.

jesseAgent.permissionMode.description: Permission mode used by VS Code local server requests. Default asks for approval before non-read-only tools.

jesseAgent.llmBaseUrl.description: Optional override for LLM_BASE_URL when the local Jesse Agent server starts. Leave empty to use .env.

jesseAgent.llmModel.description: Optional override for LLM_MODEL when the local Jesse Agent server starts. Leave empty to use .env.

jesseAgent.llmApiMode.description: Optional override for LLM_API_MODE. Leave empty to auto-detect from the base URL or use .env.

jesseAgent.llmApiKey.description: Optional override for LLM_API_KEY. Prefer .env or VS Code user settings; do not commit secrets in workspace settings.

jesseAgent.llmApiKeyHeader.description: Optional override for LLM_API_KEY_HEADER, for example api-key for Azure OpenAI. Leave empty to auto-detect.

jesseAgent.devMode.description: Show internal Jesse Agent developer controls such as health, eval, raw diff, and compact.
